packet.defect: PAY-2 retries a timed-out capture three times following RTY-1, RTY-1 takes the retry budget from TIER-1, and TIER-1 gives capture a budget of 0 because a repeat could charge the customer twice.
evidence_quotes: A capture that times out is retried three times following RTY-1
The number of retries for a call is the retry budget listed for its call type in TIER-1
